description: Famille Pouille is a French company specialized in the manufacturing and production of food and beverage products. The company operates primarily in the food and beverage sector.

La Péro is a French company engaged in the production and export of alcoholic beverages, with a focus on wine-based drinks. The company operates as a food manufacturer and food and beverage exporter, offering a sparkling, fruit-flavored alcoholic beverage made from French Chardonnay wine, which is gluten-free and free from bitterness. La Péro serves bars and consumers in France and collaborates with industry partners and the French government.
core_offerings: French Wine Ingredient Sourcing and Processing

description: Kermené is a French company specialized in the production and distribution of butcher and charcuterie products for the food and beverage sector. The company operates industrial production and logistics sites, supplying fresh meat and charcuterie products to E.Leclerc stores across the Côtes-d'Armor region and Brittany. Kermené also manages logistics platforms and is involved in food manufacturing, with a focus on sustainability and environmental protection.
core_offerings: Environmental Protection Services for Food Production
Risk Prevention Services for Food Production

description: Paniers d'Eve is a French food manufacturer operating in crop growing, fruit and vegetable processing, and truck farming.

Geyer is a French beverage manufacturer specializing in food production, with a focus on the beverage sector. The company produces a variety of drinks, including artisanal lemonade, energy drinks, beers, and a malt-based beverage, and distributes its products through large retailers, convenience stores, and impulse channels. Geyer emphasizes its Made in France heritage.

INOU is a French company engaged in the production and sale of fruits, with a focus on pressing and processing these fruits into various products. The company operates in Paris and serves the French market.

Domaine Godeau is a French beverage manufacturer and wine producer operating in the food production sector. The company is based in Beaulieu-sur-Layon, Pays de la Loire, France, and specializes in the manufacturing of beverages and food products.

Dechelette Estate is a French beverage manufacturer and food producer operating in the food production sector. The company specializes in winemaking, aging, bottling, and distribution management, serving the wine and food industry. It operates in the most prestigious terroirs of France.

La Limonaderie de Paris is a French beverage manufacturer specializing in the artisanal and local production of sparkling beverages, including standard and organic options. The company focuses on beverage manufacturing and offers both standard and organic products, serving cafes, hotels, restaurants, journalists, bloggers, influencers, and resellers in the Île-de-France region and beyond. La Limonaderie de Paris also operates as a reseller catalog provider for its products.

AUDEBERT BOISSONS Société par actions simplifiée, DBA Auvergnat Cola, is a French beverage manufacturer and distributor specialized in the production and distribution of regional beverages, with a primary focus on the Auvergne region. The company offers a range of soft drinks, including cola, lemonade, and tonic, made with locally sourced ingredients and traditional production methods. Auvergnat Cola also operates in bottling and packaging, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

L'Essinganaise is a French company specialized in the manufacturing and online sale of prepared and cooked African dishes, including traditional African cuisine, soups, and beverages. The company operates as both a food manufacturer and a service provider in the food industry, focusing on authentic African cuisine. L'Essinganaise serves customers across France and emphasizes traditional African recipes prepared with exotic and ethnic spices sourced directly from Africa, using organic ingredients and aseptic processing.
MILHADE Vins & Spiritueux is a French beverage manufacturer operating in the food production sector. The company serves vignerons, distributors, and clients in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region.

PÉPITES SAS, known as Yumi, is a French company engaged in the production and distribution of natural, organic ginger shots and maxishots, as well as other beverage products. The company operates both as a beverage distributor and a soft drinks shop, offering its products through e-commerce and retail channels. Yumi emphasizes sustainability by sourcing ginger from Peru, where it is cultivated organically, and uses cold pressing and high-pressure processing techniques in its production processes.

Elixia is a French manufacturer and distributor specialized in the production of organic limonades made from agave syrup, targeting health-conscious consumers. The company emphasizes sustainability and organic agricultural practices, sourcing ingredients from the Jurassian massif and offering products with low glycemic index and low calorie content. Elixia's offerings are available through its official website and direct contact channels.

Club-Mate is a French food and beverage manufacturer specializing in the production of natural, yerba mate-infused sparkling beverages. The company operates in both Germany and France, offering products such as Club-Mate and other flavors, and is involved in the promotion of bottle return systems for waste reduction. Club-Mate is certified vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free, and incorporates eco-friendly practices in its operations.

SAS Fermenting & Co, DBA Fermenting & Co, is a French company engaged in the artisanal production and direct-to-consumer sales of fermented beverages, with a primary focus on kombucha and related plant-based infusions. The company utilizes organic ingredients sourced locally and incorporates sustainable sourcing and waste management practices. Fermenting & Co operates as a food and beverage manufacturer and maintains a focus on environmental responsibility and the use of traditional brewing methods.

GreenLeaf Mate is a French company specialized in the production and distribution of natural, energy-boosting beverages based on maté. The company offers its products in various formats, including single servings, cocktails, and post-workout options, targeting consumers seeking healthier alternatives to traditional energy drinks. GreenLeaf Mate operates as both a beverage manufacturer and distributor, with all production and bottling activities conducted in France. The company emphasizes sustainability by using recyclable glass bottles and eco-friendly packaging.

Riviera Kombucha is a French company engaged in the production and distribution of kombucha beverages, with a focus on artisanal and locally sourced ingredients. The company operates as a food manufacturer and tea producer, offering its products to both professional and individual consumers in the French Riviera region. Riviera Kombucha emphasizes natural fermentation methods and the use of locally available plants, vegetables, and fruits in its brewing processes.

Société Coopérative d’Intérêt Collectif (SCIC), DBA LA MULTILOCALE, is a French cooperative society specialized in regenerative agriculture, food processing, and the promotion of a circular economy. The organization focuses on hyperlocal and local food production, supports local entrepreneurship, and collaborates with enterprises, local authorities, associations, consumers, and training organizations to develop multi-actor territorial projects. LA MULTILOCALE also operates as a business-to-business service provider, supplying food products and offering a platform for entrepreneurs and community members to participate in its initiatives.

primary_naics.label: Cut and Sew Apparel Manufacturing (except Contractors)

description: Christian Dior SE is a French multinational luxury goods company engaged in the design, production, and distribution of fashion and beauty products. The company operates in the luxury goods industry, offering a range of products including handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, watches, haute couture, fragrances, makeup, skincare, and home goods. Dior also manages a global network of boutiques and spas, including Dior Spa, which provides luxury wellness retreats and services. The company serves both individual consumers and businesses in multiple regions, including Europe, North America, South America, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. Dior is publicly traded on Euronext Paris and is part of the CAC All-Share index.
core_offerings: Makeup and Skincare Product Development and Production
Perfume and Fragrance Development and Production
Luxury Fashion Product Design and Manufacturing

description: Decathlon SE, DBA Decathlon, is a French company specialized in the retail of sporting goods, including clothing, sports equipment, and sportswear. The company operates a global network of stores and manages the research, design, production, logistics, and distribution of its products in-house. Decathlon also develops its own brands and collaborates with pro athletes and industry partners in its design centers and R&D labs. The company is committed to sustainability and has implemented initiatives to reduce its environmental footprint.

Conserverie Fourmi is a French company operating as a micro-conserverie and food production business, specializing in the low-tech canning and preservation of seasonal fruits, vegetables, legumes, and mushrooms using renewable energy pasteurization. The company serves local producers, particularly organic and short-circuit producers, as well as private individuals and public entities such as associations and collectivities. In addition to its core production activities, Conserverie Fourmi provides initiation workshops in home canning, including theoretical and practical training and food safety education. The company emphasizes sustainable and circular practices, with a focus on local and organic food production and preservation.
core_offerings: Home Canning Theory and Practice Training
